sources.citation: game-design: unverified product-class figure. Diagonal cutting nippers are specified in ISO 5749 (cited by number); makers of 180-200 mm (7-8 in) high-leverage models commonly quote a soft-wire cutting capacity of roughly 3 to 4 mm. Solid 8 AWG copper is 3.26 mm across (the AWG formula, NBS Handbook 100 section 2) and 6 AWG is 4.11 mm, so cut is capped at 8 AWG, rounded down for play.
